display_name: PAMF-SUP native 320 nonlinear branch prototype reweighting
description: Test one change to existing branch supervision, based on the E5 frozen branch verification signal.
authorization: Original PAMF features only, multiple native expansion methods, fully supervised, no augmentation. This matched probe covers one epoch; formal budget is 100 epochs.

data.dataset: Oxford SatIQ Zenodo 8220494, first 1010464 chronological packets
data.representation: Only 8000-point common-word prefix, resampled to the original 256-point native view before any branch encoding. Existing 11000-point cache unchanged.
data.support_query_ref: Transient source V enrollment K1/16. Independent T (50000) separately staged; no training access.

permissions.claim_scope: Only the existing 8000-point common-word L and fixed source V. No held-out test access.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Scratch and fixed 5000, 20000 and 28225 source evaluation, same model/sampler as ordinary prototype 320. No T.

execution.launch_owner: Single altered native branch prototype worker
execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU4, >=4096 MiB free and <=2 incumbents.

execution.launch_readback: Verified release SHA, real smoke, PID, working directory, GPU4 and live 200-step training with configured weights.

metric_names: individual train CE, MSE and triplet
PAMF within-satellite CE, two view CE, and posterior KL
dimensions: 1375 source K1/K16 reference classes and 12785 matched queries
28225 updates and 903200 distinct labeled records in one complete source epoch

rows.method: Native 320 PAMF-SUP with nonlinear branch prototype reweighting
rows.purpose: Transfer 10 percentage points of original branch prototype weight from reference response to nonlinear, keeping all five paths.
rows.seed_notes: Shared deterministic class-pair batching and validation references. No synthetic augmentation.
rows.scenario: Oxford native real received, paper-style random message split
rows.budget_ref: 28225 updates, same 903200 labeled waveform sequence as fused320.

notes: Only objective change: within the five existing leave-one-out branch prototypes, normalized weights 0.20, 0.20, 0.30, 0.20, 0.10 in the fixed original path order.

Total five-branch prototype weight remains 0.5. Extension-only prototype weight remains 2.0. Same seed, source L/V and 28225 updates; all existing 8000-point input and waveform-no-augmentation settings unchanged.
Training runs from scratch. Use the matching ordinary prototype 320 probe for the E1 decision.
